message:
I was reminiscing about that time my husband and I thought we could wing it during a storm, only to find ourselves scavenging for batteries and snacks like we were in a sitcom. It’s funny now, but it made me realize how much easier things could be with a little preparedness. I came across a handy resource that lays out what you might want in an emergency kit—definitely worth a look if you want to avoid our comedy of errors! 

Having a plan can bring a sense of calm, even when life throws a curveball. What’s one thing you’d want in your kit?
